## Scoring Instructions

Rate each criterion from 1-5:
- **5** - Exceptional opportunity, clear path forward
- **4** - Strong opportunity, minor challenges
- **3** - Moderate opportunity, manageable challenges
- **2** - Limited opportunity, significant challenges
- **1** - Weak opportunity, major barriers

---

| # | Criterion | Description | Score (1-5) | Weight | Weighted |
|---|-----------|-------------|-------------|--------|----------|
| 1.1 | Annual Cost Savings | Labor reduction, error elimination, faster processing | | 10% | |
| 1.2 | Revenue Impact | Faster time-to-revenue, reduced leakage | | 5% | |
| 1.3 | Risk/Compliance | Audit trails, regulatory compliance, error reduction | | 8% | |
| 1.4 | Customer Experience | Faster response, accuracy, satisfaction | | 7% | |
| | **Section Total** | | | **30%** | |

### Scoring Guide - Business Impact

| Criterion | Score 5 | Score 3 | Score 1 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| Cost Savings | >$500K annually | $100-500K | <$50K |
| Revenue Impact | Direct revenue driver | Indirect enabler | No revenue impact |
| Risk/Compliance | Critical compliance | Moderate risk | Low risk area |
| Customer Experience | Customer-facing | Internal operations | Back-office only |
